List entries with their ids, dates, and last writer.

Columns: title, short id, created, updated, updated_by.
Dates are UTC, to the day; `gage cat <query>` shows the full entry.
--header prints a labelled table instead of plain rows.

Usage:
  gage ls [flags]

Flags:
  -H, --header       print a labelled, |-delimited table instead of plain unlabelled rows
  -u, --use string   vault to operate on (default: the current vault)
